privacy.subtitle: 文派隐私政策
privacy.description: We understand the importance of privacy protection. This policy explains in detail how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. Please read the following policy carefully. Using our services indicates that you agree to these terms.

usageData.title: 1.2 Usage Data
usageData.functionalityDesc: Usage frequency, feature preferences, operation records
usageData.contentDesc: Content you input, AI-generated content, brand library information
usageData.platformAdaptDesc: Selected target platforms, content style preferences

technicalData.title: 1.3 Technical Data

technicalData.logsDesc: Access time, page views, error logs

dataUsage.title: 2. Purpose of Information Use
purposes: Service Provision: Provide core functions such as AI content generation and multi-platform adaptation
Service Improvement: Analyze usage patterns, optimize AI algorithms and user experience
Personalization: Provide personalized recommendations and services based on your preferences
Payment Processing: Handle subscription fees and payment-related transactions
Customer Support: Provide technical support and customer service
Security: Prevent fraud, abuse and system security threats
Legal Compliance: Comply with applicable laws and regulations

dataSharing.title: 3. Information Sharing Policy
dataSharing.noSalePromise: We do not sell your personal information
dataSharing.noSaleDesc: We promise not to sell, rent or trade your personal information to third parties

necessarySharing.title: 3.1 Necessary Third-Party Sharing
necessarySharing.payment: Payment Service Providers: Process subscription fees (e.g., Alipay, WeChat Pay)
necessarySharing.cloud: Cloud Service Providers: Data storage and processing (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud)
necessarySharing.ai: AI Service Providers: Provide AI content generation services
necessarySharing.support: Customer Service Platform: Provide customer support services

legal.title: 3.2 Legal Requirements
legal.disclosure: Disclose information when required by laws and regulations
legal.protection: Protect our legitimate rights and user safety
legal.cooperation: Cooperate with legal investigations by government agencies

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security Measures
measures: Encrypted Transmission: Use HTTPS and SSL encryption to protect data transmission
Encrypted Storage: Store sensitive data using strong encryption algorithms
Access Control: Strict employee permission management and access control
Security Audits: Regular security assessments and vulnerability scans
Data Backup: Regular data backups to ensure data security
Monitoring Systems: Real-time monitoring of abnormal access and security threats

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention Period
periods: Account Data: Retained during account active period, deleted within 30 days after account deletion
Usage Data: Retained for up to 2 years for service improvement
Content Data: You can choose to retain or delete, immediately cleared after deletion
Payment Data: Retained according to legal requirements, typically for 7 years
Log Data: Retained for up to 6 months for security analysis

basicRights.access: Access Right: View your personal information we collect

basicRights.deletion: Deletion Right: Request deletion of your personal information

controlRights.restriction: Restriction Right: Limit our processing of your information
controlRights.objection: Objection Right: Object to certain processing activities
controlRights.withdrawal: Withdrawal Right: Withdraw previously given consent
controlRights.complaint: Complaint Right: Complain to regulatory authorities

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
types: Necessary Cookies: Used for basic website functionality and security
Functional Cookies: Remember your preference settings
Analytics Cookies: Help us improve service quality
Third-party Cookies: Only for necessary third-party services
You can manage Cookie preferences in your browser settings
We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising

childrenPrivacy.noticeDesc: Our services are not intended for children under 13. If you discover that we have collected children's information, please contact us immediately.

If we discover we have collected children's information, we will delete it immediately

internationalTransfer.title: 9. International Data Transfer
transfers: Your data may be processed outside of China
We ensure all data transfers comply with applicable data protection laws
We adopt appropriate security measures to protect cross-border data
We sign data processing agreements with third-party service providers

Major changes will be notified via email, website announcements, or in-app notifications
Continued use of services indicates your acceptance of the updated policy
